body.p: This is a Response to the Final Office Action mailed October 25, 2024 (the "Final Office Action"), in which a three (3) month Shortened Statutory Period for Response has been set, due to expire January 25, 2025. By way of this Response, claims 1, 2, 10, 16, and 19 are amended. No claims are canceled and no new claims are added. No new matter has been added to the application. Claims 1-20 are pending.
Claim 1 was objected to due to an typographical informality, for which the
Examiner proposed a re-wording to resolve. Applicant has amended claim 1 in accordance with the Examiner's suggestion and therefore requests that the objection to claim 1 be withdrawn.
Claims 1-20 were rejected under 35 USC 103 for being allegedly unpatentable over US 20230168670 (hereafter, "von Reventlow") in view of US 20200150674 (hereafter, "Ferguson").

Applicant does not acquiesce to the Examiner's rejections of claims 1 -20, but in the interest of expediting allowance of the instant application Applicant has amended independent claim 1 to further distinguish from von Reventlow. Specifically, Applicant has acknowledged, with thanks, the Examiner's suggestion on page 2-3 of the Final Office Action that "[t]he application of prior art may be overcome by providing amendments that further limit "ancillary data" to be specifically sensor data acquired from sensor onboard the "first robot," in light of the embodiments described on page 26 of the specification filed 4/12/2022, as well as amendments defining the "control model of the first robot" to be different from the "control model of the second robot," such that the control models of each robot are not synchronized with a remote database, as taught by von Reventlow, but updated via peer-to-peer communication, as described in the Applicant's disclosure" (Final Office Action, pages 2-3). Applicant has amended independent claim 1 to include all the features suggested by the Examiner, and further amended dependent claims 2, 10, 16, and 19 simply to render the language therein consistent with the amendments made to independent claim 1.

Applicant respectfully submits that von Reventlow, in further view of Ferguson, does not teach or suggest all of the features of any of Applicant's amended claims, and therefore requests that the rejections of claims 1-20 under 35 USC 103 be withdrawn.

Applicant respectfully submits that the pending claims are in condition for allowance. Amendments and remarks are made to expedite prosecution of the instant application only and are without prejudice to claims relating to the same or similar subject matter in any other patent or application, including any continuing application.
The Examiner is encouraged to contact the undersigned by e-mail or telephone to discuss the above and any other distinctions between the claims and the applied references, if desired.
